python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
for source in Path('docs').rglob('*.md'):
    for target in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)', source.read_text()):
        if '://' in target:
            continue
        name, _, fragment = target.partition('#')
        dest = source.parent / name if name else source
        assert dest.exists(), (source, target)
        if fragment:
            headings = re.findall(r'^#+ (.+)$', dest.read_text(), re.M)
            anchors = {re.sub(r'[^\w\- ]', '', h.lower()).replace(' ', '-') for h in headings}
            assert fragment in anchors, (source, target)
print('All local documentation links and heading targets resolve.')
PY
